The '''Lothalian Corvette''' was a [[starship]] model<ref name="Ships" /> that saw action at the [[Battle of Exegol]]<ref name="TROS" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="35 ABY">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] to one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which is in turn dated to [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Thus, it could be found that the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' took place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> Multiple vessels of this [[corvette]] class were part of<ref name="TROS" /> a [[Citizens' Fleet]] of volunteer civilians from throughout [[the galaxy]] who ensured the [[Resistance]]'s victory over the [[Sith]] forces on [[Exegol]],<ref name="Lando DB">{{Databank|lando-calrissian|Lando Calrissian}}</ref> and at least one Lothalian Corvette joined the victory celebrations hosted by the Resistance at their [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[planet]] [[Ajan Kloss]] shortly after the battle.<ref name="TROS" />

Lothalian was another name for [[Lothalite]]s,<ref name="Rebels 3D">''[[Star Wars Rebels 3D Activity Book]]''</ref> a culture group of [[human]]s from the [[planet]] [[Lothal]].<ref name="Lothal DB">{{Databank|lothal|Lothal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Lothalian Corvette bears visual similarities with the [[Defender-class light corvette/Legends|''Defender''-class light corvette]], which was developed for the [[2011]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with design elements from the [[Consular-class light cruiser|''Consular''-class space cruiser]], the [[CR90 corvette]], and the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'',<ref name="Art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and was the basis of<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/a-test-of-strength-trivia-gallery|text="A Test of Strength" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref> the [[Paladin-class corvette|''Paladin''-class corvette's]] design.<ref name="ESO">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref>
